stdout:
usage: fleet-switchboard impact clear [-h] [--under-order N] --reason REASON
                                      [--revoke]
                                      pr

positional arguments:
  pr               The pull request: owner/repo#N or its URL

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --under-order N  The Chief of Staff only: clear under the owner's standing
                   order N (it must be listed under delegated_clear in the
                   configuration); recorded as her act under that order
  --reason REASON  Why the hold is false (at least 10 characters), logged
  --revoke         Take the clear back (and any carry of it): the PR is held
                   again at the daemon's next pass
